notes.title: [Lovely Games]Hypnosis Card Small Update Instructions
notes.notes:
Minor update instructions:
There were some problems with the [Hypnosis Card] launched on January 19th. It has been repaired and you can download the update. If you encounter other problems, you can give me feedback at any time. I am very sorry for the inconvenience caused to you
Partial adjustment:

 When obtaining cards, both upgraded and non-upgraded cards will be collected.
 Strengthen the card [gentle attack] [frustration] [restrain burst] [stimulation].
 The card description increases the effect value to display [Crazy Attack] and [Place].
 Reduce the use of banned cards in Nana’s final battle.

Bug fix:

 Fixed widescreen interface adaptation problem
 Fixed the problem that the mouse wheel cannot be dragged in some interfaces
 Fixed the issue of getting stuck when fighting again after having more than 10 cards in hand.
 Fixed the issue of getting stuck when clicking the end of the round when settling cards.
 Fixed the issue where using a card that discards cards in your hand will cause you to get stuck when settling cards.
 Fixed the problem of incorrect conditions for achieving Master of Hypnosis

And we have reached cooperation with our friend [Reborn Entertainment]! Buy the bundle now for an additional -15% discount. If you also like the game [Love n Life: Lucky Teacher], you can’t miss it! 
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/38055/Reborn_x_Lovely_Games/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2445340/Love_n_Life_Lucky_Teacher/

notes.title: 【Lovely Games】Some minor update instructions
notes.notes:
Some minor update instructions
 Some of the problems reported by everyone in [Hypnosis Card], which was launched on January 19, have been fixed! 


 The upper limit of cards in hand is increased to 16 cards
 If the card's function is only to draw cards, it cannot be used when the number of draw piles is 0.
 Card effects have been adjusted. The cards involved are: focus+, follow the trend attack, follow the trend attack+, forced calm, forced calm+, inner depression, inner depression+
 Fixed some bugs


 You can already update to solve the problem. If you encounter other problems, you can give feedback at any time and we will try our best to deal with it as soon as possible.
Thank you again for your understanding and love for us.
